To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dust particles in laboratory and space plasmas are not just inert tracers of the electric field, but can have a profound effect on the plasma and the plasma can have a significant effect on the dust.
the dust grains in the laboratory are charged, they have a size distribution, and the grains can be levitated.

(1) the plasma potential is the dominant force on charged particles, (2) the plasma potential can be measured using charged microparticles, (3) the plasma potential depends on the plasma parameters, (4) the plasma potential has a strong spatial variation, (5) charged microparticles can be used to measure the spatial variation of the plasma potential, and (6) charged microparticle measurements can be used to diagnose plasma parameters.

the physics of dusty plasmas in the laboratory, in industry, and in space.
the behavior of charged microparticles in plasmas and the effects of microparticles on plasmas.
the study of charged dust particles in a variety of plasmas.
